name: Grol'dom Farm
summary: Along the road from Durotar to the Crossroads, Grol'dom Farm raises swine in the northern Barrens. Kranal Fiss and his family work the homestead under constant harassment from aggressive quilboars.

sections.title: A Swine Farm in the Savannah
sections.body: After Durotar was settled, the Horde began farming the dry Barrens at Grol'dom Farm. Kranal Fiss and his children tend the homestead and raise pigs. Razormane quilboar raiders prowl the nearby ridges, making life here lonely and rugged. Still, the farm feeds the emerging orcish nation.

sections.title: A Beacon for Young Shaman
sections.body: Kranal Fiss tends pigs at Grol'dom Farm and knows the elemental rites. He guides young shaman through their trials, so Horde initiates on the spiritual path hold the farm in quiet regard. Seekers traveling west from Orgrimmar are regularly sent here to learn how to commune with the primal spirits of fire.

faq.answer: Grol'dom Farm raises swine in the northern Barrens, along the road between Durotar and the Crossroads. Established after Orgrimmar was founded, this remote homestead is worked by Kranal Fiss and his children.
Kranal Fiss and his children live at the farm. They tend the pens, herd the pigs, and defend their meager livelihood against roving beasts and quilboar raiders.

faq.q: Why do shamans come to Grol'dom Farm?
faq.answer: Kranal Fiss knows the elemental rites, and orc and tauren shaman are routinely sent to him during their early training. He guides them through trials to earn their Call of Fire and manifest the Fire Totem.
Razormane quilboars from the surrounding savannah constantly harass the farm. Their raids threaten the livestock and endanger Kranal's family.

angles.text: As a shaman initiate walking the elemental path, you come to Grol'dom Farm for the dangerous rites Kranal Fiss guides you through. These rites teach you to commune with the spirits of fire.
As a member of the Horde, you can see the grit early settlers need to make a sustainable life at Grol'dom Farm in the harsh, untamed Barrens.
